description: RAPID: Data collection at 2019 E-Defense RC Moment Frame Testing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Paolo Calvi, University of Washington (washington.edu). Structural assessment activities present two challenges - collecting high quality damage data and interpreting the acquired data in a meaningful and rational way - to produce estimates of the level of safety and residual strength of the inspected building. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Reinforced Concrete, Moment Frame, Shake Table, E-Defense, lidar, Building Damage. Published 2023-01-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
